note_frame5: Fifth continuation frame stopped at the ~25-30 per-child findings budget (26 new this frame; 156 cumulative), NOT at saturation. Across this frame's passes the new-unique rate ranged ~5-21% (the isolated snowball_round_4 pass yielded 0 because the 2026 Scientometrics/Research Evaluation/LIS Research forward-citers are not indexed in Europe PMC and had no retrievable verbatim text, so they were excluded per integrity rather than added from memory). No two consecutive passes fell below the 2% threshold, so the cluster has NOT saturated. Cumulative unique (156) remains below the 200-paper floor; the coordinator should fork a further continuation. Suggested remaining threads: resolve non-biomedical metascience venues via Crossref/publisher fulltext (Scientometrics top-2%-database critique, Research Evaluation peer-review-reform, LIS Research data-sharing-intentions), field-constrained preprint/peer-review concordance, quantified grant-application burden/success-rate, and exact-phrase 'available on request' data-obtain-rate audits.
note_frame4: Fourth continuation frame stopped at the ~25-30 per-child findings budget (27 new this frame; 130 cumulative), NOT at saturation. Across this frame's passes the new-unique rate ranged ~8-48% (well above the 2% threshold) and never fell below 2% in two consecutive passes, so the cluster has NOT saturated. The DORA/responsible-metrics thread was especially productive (12 new from one CITED-sorted EPMC pass). Cumulative unique (130) remains below the 200-paper floor; the coordinator should fork a further continuation. Suggested remaining threads: OpenAlex snowball_round_4 (Freedman/Begley-Ellis economics-of-reproducibility seeds), deeper data-paper citation-incentive work, field-constrained preprint/peer-review-concordance and team-science/hyperauthorship queries (broad EPMC CITED-sorts return genomics/health-services noise), and research-parasites data-sharing-credit (needs exact-phrase query to avoid biology 'parasites' noise).

note_frame6: Sixth continuation frame added 25 new unique-DOI findings (156 -> 181), reaching the ~22-target of a LIGHT frame (hard stop 28 not hit). FULL-TEXT PRIORITY frame: 13 of the 25 new findings (52%) are text_access=fulltext, each sourced from a genuine Europe PMC open-access fullTextXML body (>15KB, <body> present) with the source sentence verified verbatim by direct substring match against the stripped body text; three body sentences were corrected to exact form (curly apostrophe U+2019 in the 452-professors PLOS ONE study; thin-space U+2006 in '39 768' in the research-waste bibliometric; citation-marker handling in the PLOS Medicine data-transparency review). This lifted the cluster full-text rate from 19.9% (below the 20% floor) to 24.3%. New quantitative fulltext threads: (a) data-availability/obtain-rate cluster quantifying the pledge-practice gap (only 6.8% of 1,792 pledging manuscripts supplied data [pmed.1005145]; 20.8% of responding trialists shared IPD [jbies-24-00548]; raw data available for only 3.1% of 255 animal-opioid studies [adb.70027]) -> new figure_data 'data-actually-shared-rates'; (b) open-access citation advantage empirics (med-ed n=43,275 ~23% advantage RCR 1.17 vs 0.87 [10.1080/10872981.2026.2652722]; orthopaedics n=97,806 OA coef 0.175 [10.1186/s10195-026-00911-z]) vs scoping-review caveat that only 47.8% of studies find any advantage [rsos.241248] -> new CONFLICT; (c) replication-success rates (sports/exercise 28% successful [s40279]; parapsychology preregistration 16% vs 46.6% significant [peerj.21360]); (d) open-science adoption/attitudes (behavioral addictions preregistration 76%/data-sharing 65% [2006.2025.00398]; pre-post course OSF accounts 7->78 [f1000research.155832.2]; 452-professor reproducibility survey [pone.0319334]); (e) assessment-reform/incentive-culture pieces (Stockholm Declaration, generosity-as-method, trustworthiness framework, bureaucracy-as-impediment, stem-cell hyperbole reward structures, two-crises social psychology, Peru RENACYT retractions~productivity, AHSS open-research typology, Global South publishing, NIH 2025 public-access APC equity). New-unique rate stayed 0.12-0.36 across all passes (well above the 2% threshold; no two consecutive sub-2% passes), so the cluster has NOT saturated. Cumulative unique (181) remains below the 200 floor -> a further continuation is required. Remaining threads: quantified grant-application burden/success-rate, field-constrained preprint/peer-review concordance, and non-biomedical metascience venues (Scientometrics/Research Evaluation) needing Crossref/publisher fulltext.
